answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, with the stake released only after a long probation period of honest attestations. New identities start with a tiny rate limit and must earn trust gradually, like tending a garden: one verified action at a time, with slashing for contradictions. A single fast-moving comet identity cannot bypass this because creating many accounts multiplies the locked capital and waiting time, while honest agents reuse one established identity at low cost.
